name: What is the process for beginning a whole home accessibility upgrade project with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for beginning a whole home accessibility upgrade project with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your specific needs, goals, and budget for the accessibility upgrade. Following this, we conduct an on-site assessment to evaluate your current home structure and identify suitable solutions. We then develop a detailed proposal including design recommendations, a project timeline, and a transparent cost estimate. Once approved, we manage all aspects of the renovation, including permit acquisition, construction, and final inspection, ensuring a smooth and efficient upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation and on-site assessment, followed by a detailed proposal. We then manage all aspects of the renovation from permits to construction and final inspection.
